verdict.rationale: Opting out of a product's own telemetry is a fair question for a data platform with an open-source, self-hosted edition, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a way to disable RudderStack's own telemetry or usage tracking. Consent Management and PII controls govern end-customer event data the user collects, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
